unit_or_behavior: This file reviews specification completeness and traceability only for the FCS design. It does not demonstrate software behavior, aircraft safety, performance, hardware compatibility, or operational readiness.
applicability: All design-level unit tests are conditional on approved configuration and safety decisions
setup_preconditions: Use docs/design/fcs-design.md as the primary design input and cross-check docs/software_firmware_stories.md and docs/drone_flight_control_system_requirements.md
inputs_or_injected_condition: No software behavior, flight result, or aircraft safety is claimed in this file
expected_observable_result: The CSV records proposed unit-test oracles and gaps only; no aircraft approval or safety claim is implied
verification_scope: Unit tests for public behavior; SIL, HIL, bench, and flight work remain out of scope
notes: This is deliberately a desk-review specification artifact, not an executed suite.

unit_or_behavior: Test one public behavior per case; preserve explicit distinctions among valid, invalid, missing, stale, unsupported, and out-of-range states.
applicability: All supported units and interfaces
setup_preconditions: Use local fakes and a deterministic clock; never invent aircraft-specific values or implicit defaults
inputs_or_injected_condition: Inject one variable condition per case unless the source explicitly requires an interaction
expected_observable_result: The observable result is deterministic and the status is never silently coerced into a usable value
fixture_or_test_seam: Fake clock, config object, sample builder, fault arbiter, telemetry stub
notes: The design document remains the authority; implementation files are only context.

unit_or_behavior: Shared seams for the full FCS unit-test design: fake clock, config schema object, sample builders, readiness state keeper, command parser, estimator stub, setpoint limiter, actuator inhibitor, fault arbiter, and telemetry/event logger.
applicability: All units under test
setup_preconditions: Local dependency injection and explicit configuration input are used for all collaborators
inputs_or_injected_condition: Inject config values, current time, sensor data, command payloads, and fault events
expected_observable_result: Units expose publicity observable status and result without external services or hardware
fixture_or_test_seam: Local stubs/fakes and explicit injected state
notes: This seam is not a production API and does not imply hardware or network behavior.

unit_or_behavior: Modularity, interface ownership, and requirements traceability are inspection/design obligations, not a defined runtime unit behavior.
applicability: All logical modules and requirement trace links
setup_preconditions: Review logical interfaces, ownership, units, validity, timing/error contracts, and requirement-to-verification links
inputs_or_injected_condition: Inspect the approved design and trace artifacts
expected_observable_result: Inspection evidence is required; no unit-test oracle is defined by the source criteria for validating these document properties
blocking_decision_or_evidence: Target module boundaries and approved requirement baseline remain project decisions
notes: This replaces an invented runtime metadata validator.

unit_or_behavior: Reject missing or invalid build identity information.
applicability: Clean checkout and build identity output
setup_preconditions: Create a local build-identity fixture and a valid build result
inputs_or_injected_condition: Inject missing revision, missing target, malformed version, or unsupported configuration identity
expected_observable_result: The build identity object is rejected or reported invalid; no ready/armed state can proceed on invalid identity
blocking_decision_or_evidence: The exact build-identity schema and source-revision format are still implementation-defined
notes: This case validates the reproducibility and identity requirements without running a full build.

unit_or_behavior: Reject malformed, missing, unsupported, or out-of-range flight configuration before use.
applicability: Configured flight-control parameters
setup_preconditions: Use a local configuration validator with explicit schema and limits
inputs_or_injected_condition: Inject each invalid class separately: missing field, malformed field type, unsupported feature flag, and out-of-range numeric value
expected_observable_result: The validator reports a diagnostic and blocks usage of the affected configuration; armed-state mutation is rejected when a protected field is changed
blocking_decision_or_evidence: The exact configuration schema and protected fields remain TBD; the test oracle remains symbolic
notes: This includes the fail-closed gate and armed-state protection requirement without inventing target limits.

unit_or_behavior: Startup readiness is gated by critical check results and exposes an inhibit reason.
requirement_ids: FCS-F-001; FCS-F-002; FCS-F-003; FCS-F-004; FCS-F-007; FCS-F-008
applicability: Configured startup sequence and sensor/actuator interfaces
setup_preconditions: Use a startup manager fixture with injected pass/fail check results
inputs_or_injected_condition: Inject a passing check and each configured critical-check failure in separate runs
expected_observable_result: A critical failure leaves the system not ready and inhibits arming; readiness or inhibit status and reason are observable; calibration follows the declared procedure when enabled
blocking_decision_or_evidence: Startup sequence, check criticality, readiness criteria, and calibration policy are external decisions not yet baselined
notes: This is a unit test for the manager contract, not the target startup sequence itself.

unit_or_behavior: IMU acquisition time-aligns and rejects invalid or stale samples.
applicability: Configured IMU adapter and sample clock
setup_preconditions: Run a local adapter fixture with a fake clock and injected IMU samples
inputs_or_injected_condition: Inject valid sample, stale sample, timeout, ordering error, and communication failure
expected_observable_result: Valid data is converted and time-aligned; stale and failed samples are marked invalid or interface-error and do not reach estimation as valid inputs
blocking_decision_or_evidence: Protocol, units, timestamp semantics, and maximum age are still external decisions
fixture_or_test_seam: IMU device adapter and timestamp alignment seam
notes: This covers the adapter contract without requiring actual hardware.

unit_or_behavior: Validate sensor freshness, range, missing, and invalid cases with explicit rejection reasons.
applicability: Configured sensor sample validator
setup_preconditions: Use a local validator fixture and a fake clock
inputs_or_injected_condition: Inject fresh in-range sample, stale sample, missing sample, out-of-range sample, invalid sample, and zero value with different validity statuses
expected_observable_result: Each sample is classified as valid or invalid with a reason; zero is only valid when allowed by config; invalid sample does not satisfy downstream prerequisites
blocking_decision_or_evidence: Per-sensor limits and fault thresholds remain TBD; no target numeric values are assumed
fixture_or_test_seam: Sample validator and downstream consumer probe
notes: This is the canonical unit-level SF-006 oracle.

unit_or_behavior: Arming gate accepts or rejects transitions only when prerequisites and reasons are valid.
applicability: Configured arming state machine and gate checks
setup_preconditions: Use a deterministic state-machine fixture
inputs_or_injected_condition: Inject disarmed request, armed request, stale prerequisite, invalid prerequisite, conflicting transition, and each failed-gate reason
expected_observable_result: State transitions are deterministic; stale or invalid status cannot satisfy a gate; rejected transitions expose a reason and do not arm
blocking_decision_or_evidence: Approved transition rules and gate conditions are external safety decisions
notes: This is not a hardware or pilot-operational approval case.

unit_or_behavior: Disarmed actuator output remains inhibited regardless of setpoint or command content.
applicability: Configured actuator boundary and setpoint inputs
setup_preconditions: Use a local actuator inhibit fixture
inputs_or_injected_condition: Inject arbitrary non-zero setpoints while disarmed and then arm only after all gates pass
expected_observable_result: All channels remain at the configured inhibit value while disarmed; disarming restores inhibition deterministically; arming does not remove the inhibitor by itself
blocking_decision_or_evidence: The exact inhibit value and output contract are external decisions; output range and channel order remain TBD
fixture_or_test_seam: Actuator inhibitor and output allocator seam
notes: This is a contract-level dependency case for SF-008/SF-014.

unit_or_behavior: Fault severity and arbitration resolve deterministic selected response for single and simultaneous faults.
applicability: Hazard-approved fault table and priority map
setup_preconditions: Use a fault arbiter fixture with explicit severity and response rules
inputs_or_injected_condition: Inject a single fault and then combinations of faults in defined priority order
expected_observable_result: Only the approved response is selected; active reason and safety priority are deterministic; safety actions preempt mission and telemetry work
blocking_decision_or_evidence: Hazard analysis and approved response table are missing; fault severity, priority, and recovery are not yet baselined
fixture_or_test_seam: Fault severity table and arbitration fixture
notes: The test can only be specified symbolically until the hazard analysis is approved.

unit_or_behavior: Monitor timing violations, overload, and watchdog state without spurious arming.
requirement_ids: FCS-NF-001; FCS-NF-003; FCS-NF-008; FCS-NF-009; FCS-S-007; FCS-S-008
applicability: Runtime monitor and scheduler status
setup_preconditions: Use a deterministic timer and watchdog fixture
inputs_or_injected_condition: Inject deadline miss, overload condition, and watchdog/reset event
expected_observable_result: Fault or status event is raised within the configured budget; no spurious arm occurs; observable reset and degraded state are reported
blocking_decision_or_evidence: Processor, timing budgets, watchdog design, and reset policy are external platform decisions
notes: This is bounded to the monitor contract, not target execution-time evidence.

unit_or_behavior: Reject malformed, stale, missing, or out-of-range pilot commands and map accepted ones to mode-specific setpoints.
applicability: Command parser and mode mapping fixture
setup_preconditions: Use a local parser with explicit time and mode context
inputs_or_injected_condition: Inject valid command, malformed payload, stale time, missing command, and out-of-range command
expected_observable_result: Accepted commands map to the declared mode-specific setpoints; invalid input does not bypass limits and exposes a rejection reason
blocking_decision_or_evidence: Link protocol, ranges, freshness budget, and invalid-command policy are still external decisions
fixture_or_test_seam: Command parser and mode mapping fixture
notes: Covers the parser/validator contract without assuming field protocols.

unit_or_behavior: Estimator publishes attitude and angular-rate validity and rejects stale or invalid inputs.
applicability: Configured estimator input and validity contract
setup_preconditions: Use a deterministic estimator fixture with local reference vectors
inputs_or_injected_condition: Inject valid IMU data, invalid sample, stale sample, and communication failure
expected_observable_result: Outputs remain valid only when required inputs are valid; invalid or stale inputs produce invalid estimates and preserve the validity contract
blocking_decision_or_evidence: Estimator algorithm, alignment, confidence semantics, and latency limits are external design decisions
notes: This case stays unit-level and does not claim target-control performance.

unit_or_behavior: Setpoint limiting enforces configured bounds and transition-rate limits.
applicability: Configured setpoint limit object and rate limiter
setup_preconditions: Use a local limit-controller fixture
inputs_or_injected_condition: Inject values at, below, and above each limit and abrupt transitions inside and outside the rate limit
expected_observable_result: The output stays within bounds and transition rates; invalid limits reject activation; limiting or saturation is observable
blocking_decision_or_evidence: Aircraft operational limits and transition-rate values are external decisions
notes: This is a pure contract check and does not assume target flight performance.

unit_or_behavior: Output allocation converts bounded demands to motor commands and reports saturation.
applicability: Configured airframe geometry and ESC range
setup_preconditions: Use a local mixer allocator fixture
inputs_or_injected_condition: Inject valid demand, invalid geometry, invalid input, and demand above the maximum allocator capacity
expected_observable_result: The allocator produces bounded demands within ESC range and reports saturation when required; a single invalid input cannot produce unbounded output
blocking_decision_or_evidence: Airframe geometry, motor order, direction, and inhibit value remain TBD
notes: This validates deterministic allocation behavior but not target hardware outputs.

unit_or_behavior: Rate controller tracks bounded demand and prevents integral windup during saturation.
applicability: Configured rate-controller gains and saturation limits
setup_preconditions: Use a local controller fixture with deterministic state
inputs_or_injected_condition: Inject bounded valid demand, invalid state, saturated demand, and anti-windup condition
expected_observable_result: Controller output follows the correct direction for the error and holds the integral term from growing uncontrollably during saturation
blocking_decision_or_evidence: Controller gains, loop rate, and performance acceptance limits are external design decisions
notes: Performance is symbolic and design-dependent, not target-certified.

unit_or_behavior: Attitude loop converts attitude error into bounded rate demand or degraded behavior.
applicability: Configured attitude controller and estimator status
setup_preconditions: Use a deterministic attitude-loop fixture
inputs_or_injected_condition: Inject valid estimate, invalid estimate, and large attitude error
expected_observable_result: The output rate demand direction matches the error sign and remains within configured limits; invalid estimate inhibits or selects the approved degraded behavior
blocking_decision_or_evidence: Attitude-control design and tracking criteria remain external decisions
notes: This is a contract-level loop check, not target performance evidence.

unit_or_behavior: Scheduler decision function reports deadline status from injected cycle timestamps.
applicability: Timing budget is supplied as a test fixture parameter.
setup_preconditions: Use a deterministic scheduler-decision function with a fake clock.
inputs_or_injected_condition: Submit cycle start/end timestamps and a symbolic allocated budget.
expected_observable_result: The decision result reports within-budget or missed-deadline consistently with the injected budget; no elapsed-time performance claim is made.
blocking_decision_or_evidence: Target cycle, latency, and load budgets remain TBD.
fixture_or_test_seam: Pure scheduler decision function; fake clock
notes: Scheduling on target and resource contention remain separate evidence.

unit_or_behavior: Mode entry and transition gates accept only supported valid prerequisites.
applicability: Configured mode-gate table and valid state inputs
setup_preconditions: Use a mode-gate fixture with explicit transitions
inputs_or_injected_condition: Inject allowed transitions, prohibited transitions, repeated transitions, invalid required state, and missing mode prerequisites
expected_observable_result: The active mode and transition reason are observable; unsupported or invalid prerequisites prevent entry or exit according to policy
blocking_decision_or_evidence: Supported modes, priorities, and transition behavior are external decisions
notes: The test remains independent of target aircraft specific mode names or priorities.

unit_or_behavior: Fault-driven degraded or failsafe state selection honors validity and safety priority.
requirement_ids: FCS-F-025; FCS-F-076; FCS-F-079; FCS-S-003; FCS-S-005; FCS-S-008; FCS-S-010; FCS-S-014
applicability: Configured safety selector and approved response map
setup_preconditions: Use a local safety seletor fixture with explicit fault precedence
inputs_or_injected_condition: Inject invalid flight-critical state, critical sensor loss, unavailable navigation, and competing faults
expected_observable_result: The selected degraded or failsafe response matches the approved behavior for the fault and safety priority; recovery only occurs under explicit approved conditions
blocking_decision_or_evidence: Hazard-approved response, unique priority, and recovery conditions are external safety authority inputs
fixture_or_test_seam: Fault selector and active safety-state observer
notes: This is a contract to select the approved response, not a flight-safety authorization.

unit_or_behavior: Altitude and navigation sources are accepted only when valid and configured.
requirement_ids: FCS-F-015; FCS-F-016; FCS-F-017; FCS-F-018; FCS-F-022; FCS-F-023
applicability: Configured altitude/navigation source catalog
setup_preconditions: Use a source-validation fixture for barometer, GNSS, and optional sensors
inputs_or_injected_condition: Inject each installed source, absent source, invalid source, and magnetometer case
expected_observable_result: Outputs carry validity and source status; invalid input never becomes valid altitude or navigation state; unsupported or absent source is reported as unsupported or unavailable
blocking_decision_or_evidence: Installed sensors and fusion policy are airframe-specific decisions
notes: Unit tests isolate source validity rather than the full navigation system.

unit_or_behavior: Altitude Hold entry gate requires a valid configured altitude estimate.
applicability: Configured Altitude Hold prerequisite gate.
setup_preconditions: Use a local gate fixture with explicit altitude validity state.
inputs_or_injected_condition: Request entry with valid, missing, and invalid altitude estimate in separate invocations.
expected_observable_result: Gate permits entry only for valid configured estimate; otherwise it rejects entry and identifies the unsatisfied prerequisite.
blocking_decision_or_evidence: Altitude Hold support, altitude source, and entry policy require configuration approval.
fixture_or_test_seam: Altitude Hold gate with estimate-status fake
notes: Regulation and in-flight source-loss behavior are not asserted here.

unit_or_behavior: Position Hold entry gate requires valid position and velocity estimates.
applicability: Configured Position Hold prerequisite gate.
setup_preconditions: Use a local gate fixture with explicit position and velocity validity state.
inputs_or_injected_condition: Request entry with both valid, then missing or invalid position/velocity states separately.
expected_observable_result: Gate permits entry only when both estimates are valid; otherwise it rejects entry and identifies the failed prerequisite.
blocking_decision_or_evidence: Supported navigation sources and Position Hold enablement are external decisions.
fixture_or_test_seam: Position Hold gate with position/velocity fakes
notes: Navigation-loss handling is separately blocked and/or non-unit evidence.

unit_or_behavior: Enabled flight-envelope constraints enforce altitude, speed, and geofence limits using valid source data.
applicability: Configured geofence and envelope checks
setup_preconditions: Use a local envelope guard fixture
inputs_or_injected_condition: Inject values inside the envelope, at the boundary, above the limit, and with invalid or unavailable data
expected_observable_result: The envelope check accepts only valid configured data, rejects invalid data, and reports the specific constraint violated or unsupported
blocking_decision_or_evidence: The exact speed, geofence, and altitude limits plus equality semantics require approval; no target criteria are assumed
notes: This is a pure constraint validation case when the injected decision contract is approved.

unit_or_behavior: Mission input validation rejects malformed, unsupported, or out-of-constraint mission data.
applicability: Configured mission schema and capability map
setup_preconditions: Use a local mission validator fixture
inputs_or_injected_condition: Inject valid mission, malformed mission, unsupported command, and each configured constraint violation
expected_observable_result: Each invalid mission is rejected with a reason and cannot start execution or arm the aircraft; valid mission remains accepted
blocking_decision_or_evidence: Mission schema, aircraft capability map, and operational constraints remain external decisions
notes: This covers mission validation without claiming a mission execution result.

unit_or_behavior: Takeoff and landing paths follow approved sequencing and prohibit unapproved in-flight disarm.
applicability: Configured takeoff/landing sequence and output schedule
setup_preconditions: Use a deterministic takeoff-landing fixture
inputs_or_injected_condition: Inject nominal takeoff, landing, interrupted landing, invalid input, and disarm request
expected_observable_result: The output sequence matches the approved behavior; unapproved automatic in-flight disarm is rejected; invalid transitions expose a reason
blocking_decision_or_evidence: Takeoff/landing criteria, touchdown conditions, and output sequence are external approvals
fixture_or_test_seam: Takeoff/landing state path and output observer
notes: Propeller-off bench work remains out of scope for this unit check.

unit_or_behavior: Command-link monitor classifies injected pilot-command validity and freshness state.
applicability: Configured command-link status input and symbolic timeout.
setup_preconditions: Use a local monitor and fake clock with independent telemetry status.
inputs_or_injected_condition: Inject valid, invalid, missing, disconnected, and timed-out command states separately.
expected_observable_result: Monitor exposes the corresponding command-link status; telemetry status does not alter that classification.
blocking_decision_or_evidence: Command protocol, timeout boundary, and detection budget require interface decisions.
fixture_or_test_seam: Command-link monitor with fake clock and telemetry-status stub
notes: Approved response selection and detection-time acceptance are separate.

unit_or_behavior: Battery measurement classifier preserves validity and distinguishes configured warning from critical threshold states.
applicability: Configured battery monitor and symbolic threshold table.
setup_preconditions: Use a local classifier with valid measurement status and explicit threshold inputs.
inputs_or_injected_condition: Inject valid values below, at, and above each configured threshold, plus missing and implausible measurements.
expected_observable_result: Valid readings classify according to injected threshold semantics; warning and critical remain distinct; invalid or missing readings are not treated as valid threshold crossings.
blocking_decision_or_evidence: Threshold values, units, equality semantics, and measurement validity rules require approved configuration.
fixture_or_test_seam: Battery classifier with symbolic threshold config
notes: No battery failsafe response is asserted.

unit_or_behavior: RTL prerequisite gate rejects missing or invalid home/navigation and reports unsupported RTL.
applicability: RTL enablement and home/navigation status are explicit inputs.
setup_preconditions: Use a local RTL gate with explicit prerequisite statuses.
inputs_or_injected_condition: Request RTL with valid prerequisites, missing/invalid home or navigation, and disabled RTL separately.
expected_observable_result: Gate permits initiation only when configured prerequisites are valid; otherwise it rejects with the failed prerequisite or unsupported status.
blocking_decision_or_evidence: RTL support, home definition, and required navigation source are aircraft-specific decisions.
fixture_or_test_seam: RTL prerequisite gate with status fakes
notes: Route execution and navigation-loss response are not asserted here.

unit_or_behavior: Emergency behavior is selected only from the approved hazard response map.
applicability: Configured emergency trigger mapping
setup_preconditions: Use a local emergency-selector fixture
inputs_or_injected_condition: Inject each supported trigger and an unapproved trigger configuration
expected_observable_result: Each trigger maps to the approved response and rationale; no generic motor-stop response is selected without explicit approval
blocking_decision_or_evidence: Aircraft hazard analysis and approved emergency behavior are still external decisions; no safe generic stop is assumed
notes: This is a design-controlled selection contract, not flight authorization.

unit_or_behavior: Health status projection reports supplied supported fields without exposing control commands.
applicability: Health field allowlist and internal status object are injected.
setup_preconditions: Use a pure health-status mapper with explicit supported fields.
inputs_or_injected_condition: Provide sensor validity, battery, active mode, arming, and failsafe status plus an unsupported control field.
expected_observable_result: Output reflects supplied supported status fields and excludes fields outside the allowlist.
blocking_decision_or_evidence: Health schema and diagnostic privacy/security boundary require interface decisions.
fixture_or_test_seam: Pure health mapper with field allowlist

unit_or_behavior: Event log records ordered, timestamped, bounded entries without exposing unsafe control data.
applicability: Configured event log and storage contract
setup_preconditions: Use a deterministic event logger fixture
inputs_or_injected_condition: Inject normal event, fault event, mode event, storage-full state, and persistent-storage condition
expected_observable_result: Entries remain ordered and timestamped, the storage result is explicit, and control data is not exposed beyond approved logging scope
blocking_decision_or_evidence: Storage capability, retention policy, and event schema are external decisions
fixture_or_test_seam: Event log and bounded logger seam

unit_or_behavior: Supply, environmental, and electromagnetic qualification criteria have no unit-test oracle.
